_about: Facts true of one specific file, kept out of the splitters' code (to-do-list.md, A3). The ICAI compilation holds several laws in one PDF; we take only its Rules from it (there is no official consolidated copy of the Rules). The Acts come from India Code instead (decided 2026-11-03): CGST, IGST, UTGST and Compensation Acts, split by act.py. Each part gets its own name, so its units get their own ids (CGST and IGST Rules both have a rule 2). Pages are the PDF's own, 1-based, inclusive; checked by the user in Preview 2026-11-03. Pages left out: 1-19 front matter and index, 20-181 the CGST Act (used only as icai.py's held-out test), 182-183 ICAI's notes, 364-391 IGST Act, 404-440 UTGST and Compensation Acts, 441-442 blank and ICAI's address.
